0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5, 14th in the East, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (6-1, 1st in the East and 1st in the Atlantic, on a three-game winning streak), in the Bulls' seventh game of the 2026-27 season. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 2-1, but Philadelphia beat Chicago 157-137 in their last meeting, on March 25, 2026, in Philadelphia. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Dailyn Swain is day-to-day with back soreness and is a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), Joel Embiid (out, foot), and LeBron James (out, back).
